sources.title: HuggingFaceBio/Carbon-X · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Chat model: post-trained and evaluated with thinking disabled. Context window: 40,960 tokens. Training: 302B tokens of mid-training on DNA, biology text, English and instruction data, then supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards on DNA tasks. Efficient inference: serves with vLLM on a single GPU. Carbon-X uses a standard causal LM architecture.

sources.snippet: According to Hugging Face’s model card, Carbon-X has 14.8 billion parameters and starts from Qwen3-14B. Its developers trained it on DNA and natural-language text, using a tokenizer that reads DNA in six-base groups.
